units.source_text: 午饭后不到三小时，又吃了晚饭。

en.t: Less than three hours after lunch, we ate dinner again.

units.source_text: 我一个人过了桥，向下田北走去，攀登下田的富士山，眺望海港的景致。

en.t: I crossed the bridge alone, walked north of Shimoda, climbed Shimoda's Mount Fuji, and looked out over the harbor scenery.

units.source_text: 归途经过“甲州屋”，看见艺人们在吃鸡肉火锅。

en.t: On the way back, I passed Koshuya and saw the performers eating chicken hot pot.
